meta.title: A stage always gets a bidding-time schedule row
gaps: No direct read of TradeSchedule family; verification relies on round fields that map to the schedule.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with the bid start time moved later, with the bid end time moved later.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “starting from” equals {{now}}; “ending at” equals {{now+600}}.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “starting from” equals {{now}}; “ending at” equals {{now+600}}.
